We are pleased to offer you the position of Campus
Ambassador at Persevex, our innovative and dynamic
EdTech company. As a Campus Ambassador, you will play
a vital role in representing Persevex at your institution,
engaging students, and promoting our programs and
initiatives. 
Your Key Responsibilities: 
1. Representing Persevex on your campus and building
brand awareness. 
2. Promoting our training programs, internships, and events
to students. 
3. Encouraging participation in Persevex initiatives through
creative campaigns. 
4. Sharing feedback and insights to strengthen our
outreach efforts.
Dear 
 
Subject: Appointment as Campus Ambassador
Date : 
www.persevex.com
support@persevex.com
Test Candidate
September 18, 2026

Benefits of Being a Persevex Campus Ambassador: 
Gain leadership and marketing experience. 
Access exclusive training and mentorship opportunities. 
Certificate of Completion and Appreciation at the end of
the tenure. 
Rewards and incentives based on performance. 
The intern will be provided a stipend of ₹150 per
registration of students who have taken part in our
programs through the campus ambassador. 
Letter of Recommendation based on their performance.
The campus ambassador should make sure to get
Registration of at least 12 in total in order to take up a
program by himself / herself or to be eligible for stipend. 
We are confident that your enthusiasm and leadership will
make a significant impact on the success of Persevex’s
mission.
 
Welcome aboard Let’s work together to create opportunities
and inspire success! 
www.persevex.com
support@persevex.com

Date :  30/08/2025
Dear Manoj Kumar,
                       We are pleased to offer you a 6 Months Internship/Probation Period with Persevex
LLP on an “at-will basis,” which can be extended based on mutual agreement.  Please find
below the details confirming your engagement:
Training Date: 25/09/2025 to 05/10/2025
Internship Start Date: 05/10/2025
Internship End Date: 26/03/2026
                     Your job title will be “Business Development Intern / Probationary Associate.” Your
responsibilities will include those for which you are directly engaged, as well as any additional
duties assigned by your reporting manager. By accepting this offer, you agree to perform all
assigned tasks with due care, diligence, and in full compliance with company policies. You are
required to devote your time and effort exclusively to your duties during business hours, as well
as any additional time as required to complete your responsibilities.
            You will be eligible for a stipend of ₹15,000 per month, along with ₹10,000 as
performance-based incentives, subject to statutory deductions per company policy. As an
intern/probationary associate, you will not receive employee benefits that are available to full-
time employees. During this period, the company reserves the right to terminate your
services without cause, and you are required to give a 15-day notice if you wish to end the
internship/probation period before its scheduled conclusion.
                  By accepting this offer, you acknowledge that all information shared during your
internship/probation period is strictly confidential. You agree not to use or disclose this
information for personal gain or share it with anyone outside the company. Upon completion of
your tenure, you must return all company property, including equipment and electronically
stored information.
Offer Letter for Internship/Probation Period
